phase.previousPhaseCheckpoint: phase-1-complete (commit 93571b6, Level 3 review accepted round 2, EV-0047)

milestone.description: Blueprint Engine, Component Registry, Build Planner, generated-app data layer, structured renderer — the technical foundation Phase 2's demonstration product is built on

completed: P2-01: Blueprint Engine — versioned/validated Blueprint model, deterministic generator from Product State/DNA/Requirements, structural validation (EV-0048, EV-0049, D-0019)

knownLimitations: Blueprint generation (P2-01) is deterministic/template-based, keyed off the Requirements Engine's Impact Analysis categories — not real design intelligence. Every generated Blueprint discloses this via generationMetadata.generatedBy and generationMetadata.method. Real AI-backed generation is Phase 3 scope (§61).
No Build Planner, Component Registry, renderer, or generation pipeline exists yet — a Blueprint is a structured document only; nothing yet turns it into a running application (P2-02..P2-06).
Blueprint has no Studio UI surface yet (P2-17 wires this up); it is currently reachable only via the service layer and its integration tests.
Every Phase 1 known limitation not resolved by Phase 2's scope still applies (see PHASE_1_COMPLETION_REPORT.md).
nextAction: Begin P2-02: Component Registry — a validated registry of the Master Spec §26 component primitives (Screen, Stack, Grid, Heading, Text, Image, Icon, Button, Card, List, Form, Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, DatePicker, TimePicker, Badge, Tabs, Modal, Drawer, BottomNavigation, TopNavigation, Divider, LoadingState, EmptyState, ErrorState), with unknown components failing safely — the foundation P2-03 (Build Planner) and P2-05 (Structured Renderer) consume.
